## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `asb-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create an Azure Service Bus namespace

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [Azure portal](https://portal.azure.com/). -->
2. In the left navigation pane, select **All services** > **Integration** > **Service Bus**, then select **Create** on the Service Bus tile.
3. <!-- manual: On the Create namespace page, fill in the following fields: -->
4. <!-- manual: Subscription: Select your Azure subscription. -->
5. <!-- manual: Resource group: Select an existing resource group or create a new one. -->
6. <!-- manual: Namespace name: Enter a globally unique name. The name must be 6–50 characters, contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens, start with a letter, and end with a letter or number. -->
7. <!-- manual: Location: Choose the region closest to you. -->
8. - **Pricing tier**: Select **Standard** or **Premium**. Standard supports topics and subscriptions; Basic supports queues only.
9. Select **Review + create**, review the settings, then select **Create**.
10. <!-- manual: review the settings -->

## Step 3: Create a queue or topic

1. In your Service Bus namespace, select **Queues** from the left menu and select **+ Queue**.
2. Enter a **Name** (for example, `my-queue`), configure optional settings.
3. Select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a Name (for example, my-queue), configure optional settings, and select Create. -->
5. Select **Topics** from the left menu and select **+ Topic**.
6. Enter a **Name** (for example, `my-topic`).
7. Select **Create**.
8. <!-- manual: Enter a Name (for example, my-topic) and select Create. -->
9. Open the topic, select **+ Subscription**, enter a **Name** (for example, `my-subscription`), and select **Create**.
10. <!-- manual: Open the topic, select + Subscription, enter a Name (for example, my-subscription), and select Create. -->

## Step 4: Get the connection string

1. In your Service Bus namespace, select **Shared access policies** under **Settings**.
2. Select **RootManageSharedAccessKey** policy (or create a custom policy with only the required claims).
